abi_checkout: Use a separate honk worktree at 6b700f93ce8f3af0096ab41608fc5a0b12b6b9eb (ac7 baseline has the same shared ABI). The bench branch itself predates this routing ABI.
setup: Create candidate-source as a symlink to that worktree. It is intentionally untracked; the emitter defaults to the frozen candidate-codegen.rs.
ablations: Set HONK_FACT_EMITTER to the absolute state-only-codegen.rs or key-only-codegen.rs path when invoking Cargo; use a separate generated/output path for each.
root_probe: In an isolated code worktree, temporarily include root_probe.rs as a test module at the end of crates/honk-core/src/ebpf/real/routing/tests.rs, build with --features ebpf, execute paired_root_slot / mixed_extension_statistics with the output envs below, then remove only that temporary module. The probe fingerprints compiler-embedded source bytes.
historical_arm_script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
E=/tmp/honk-ready-flow.fmpAij
export HONK_ROUTING_TEST_OBJECT="$E/honk-ebpf"
export HONK_FACT_READY_EXT_RESULTS="$E/ext-statistics-arm.json"
export HONK_FACT_READY_ROOT_RESULTS="$E/root-paired-arm.json"
uname -a
"$E/flow-tests-aarch64" ebpf::real::routing::tests --ignored --skip paired_root_slot --skip mixed_extension_statistics --test-threads=1 --nocapture
"$E/flow-tests-aarch64" mixed_extension_statistics --ignored --nocapture
taskset -c 0 "$E/flow-tests-aarch64" paired_root_slot --ignored --nocapture
printf '%s\n' FLOW_ARM_GATES_PASS

cross_build: Use ci/zigcc and ci/zigcxx with aarch64-linux-musl, -C link-self-contained=no, and ci/zig-bindgen-env. Preserve the parent HOME in the build environment; this router requires scp -O.
proof_binding: Baseline, compiled source, emitted bodies, and kernel statistics are bound by SHA-256. final-bytecode-equivalence.json records the final identity-conversion cleanup.
